profile.shortLabel: Computer Science Student | Research Enthusiast | Aspiring Data Analyst
profile.heroIntro: I am a Computer Science student passionate about research, data analysis, and technology. I enjoy exploring complex problems, working with data, developing meaningful insights, and transforming information into solutions that support informed decision-making.
profile.heroStatement: Curious by nature. Analytical in thinking. Research-driven in purpose.
profile.aboutBio:
I am Arian Jay G. Maala, a Bachelor of Science in Computer Science student at Biliran Province State University. My academic journey has been shaped by a strong commitment to learning, research, leadership, and continuous improvement.

I am particularly interested in research because it allows me to investigate problems, examine evidence, analyze information, and develop meaningful conclusions. I believe that data becomes more valuable when it is transformed into insights that help people understand problems and make informed decisions.

My background in Computer Science has encouraged me to explore the intersection of technology, statistics, data analysis, and machine learning. I am continuously developing my technical skills while seeking opportunities to apply analytical thinking to real-world problems.

Beyond academics, my involvement in student leadership has strengthened my communication, collaboration, organization, and problem-solving abilities.

My long-term goal is to become a Data Analyst who can combine research, technical knowledge, and analytical skills to support evidence-based decision-making and contribute to meaningful projects.
profile.careerGoal: My goal is to transform data into knowledge, knowledge into insights, and insights into meaningful decisions.
profile.visionText: My ambition is to become a Data Analyst who uses research, statistics, technology, and critical thinking to transform data into meaningful insights.
profile.contactText: I am open to opportunities to learn, collaborate, participate in research, and develop projects involving technology and data analysis.

projects.title: Automated Student Class Record Monitoring (ASCReM) Web Application
projects.summary: The Automated Student Class Record Monitoring (ASCReM) Web Application focuses on providing instructors of the School of Technology and Computer Studies (STCS) with a platform for managing class records such as attendance, scores, grades, and reports. The system includes modules for authentication, dashboard viewing, class management, attendance tracking, grade computation, report generation, and account customization. It allows instructors to export attendance sheets and grade reports and access real-time summaries of student performance.
